name: prometheus_api_call
description: Call the Prometheus HTTP API (PromQL). Read-only (everything=low blast radius). Rooted at the configured Prometheus URL; pass paths under /api/v1/...

function.name: prometheus_api_call
function.description:
Call the Prometheus HTTP API (rooted at the configured URL). Auth (basic, bearer, and/or X-Scope-OrgID for multi-tenant) is already configured — do NOT use requests.

RETURN VALUE: a JSON string; json.loads it -> {"status_code", "data", "error", "blast_radius"}. NOTE Prometheus nests its own {"status":"success","data":{...}} inside our `data`, so read r["data"]["data"].

KEY ENDPOINTS (all GET, all low):
  GET /api/v1/query?query=<promql>[&time=<rfc3339|unix>]   Instant query. data.data.result = [{metric, value:[ts,val]}]
  GET /api/v1/query_range?query=<promql>&start=<t>&end=<t>&step=<dur>   Range query. result values are a matrix.
  GET /api/v1/label/__name__/values                        All metric names
  GET /api/v1/labels                                       All label names
  GET /api/v1/label/{name}/values                          Values for one label
  GET /api/v1/targets                                      Scrape targets; data.data.activeTargets = [{labels, health, lastError}]
  GET /api/v1/metadata[?metric=<name>]                     Metric type/help metadata
  GET /api/v1/status/config                                Running config
  GET /-/healthy                                           Health probe

PromQL TIPS: rate(counter[5m]) for per-second rates; use label matchers up{job="node"}; aggregate with sum by (instance)(...).

BLAST RADIUS: everything is low (read-only). If a query 400s, the PromQL is malformed — read data for the parse error. On 401, credentials are wrong.

body.description: Request body (rarely needed; queries use query_params)
